title: Tallgrass wind farm telemetry
brief: Windspire Energy needs an architecture page for the telemetry pipeline at its Tallgrass wind farm, owned by Asset Performance and reviewed 2026-10-06, to be read by the control room team on tablets. "Overview": two sentences, turbine data is collected on site and summarized before it is sent over a limited link, and the grid operator receives output and availability figures directly from the site. Under "Pipeline" show the "Tallgrass Site", containing 62 "Turbine Controllers", a "Site SCADA" system and an "Edge Historian"; and the "Windspire Operations Cloud", containing an "Ingest Gateway", a "Time-Series Store" and a "Forecast Service". Outside both sit the "Grid Operator" and the "Control Room". Flows: Turbine Controllers to Site SCADA "1 sample per second"; Site SCADA to Edge Historian "buffered storage"; Site SCADA to Grid Operator "output and availability, every 4 seconds"; Edge Historian to Ingest Gateway "compressed batches over satellite or fiber"; Ingest Gateway to Time-Series Store "validated samples"; Time-Series Store to Forecast Service "history"; Forecast Service to Control Room "24 hour output forecast"; Time-Series Store to Control Room "live and historical views". Under "Sizing" give the numbers: 62 turbines with 140 signals each, so 8680 samples per second and about 750 million samples a day; full-resolution data is kept 30 days and one-minute averages are kept 5 years; the fiber link is 100 Mbps and the satellite fallback is 2 Mbps, which can carry one-minute averages only. Flag clearly that when the site is on satellite fallback the Control Room sees averages, not full-resolution data, and that the Edge Historian can hold 72 hours of full-resolution data until the fiber link returns.

edit.request: Change the satellite fallback from 2 Mbps to 5 Mbps, and add a node called "Alarm Pager" outside the site and the cloud, with an arrow from Site SCADA labeled "fault alarms".
